notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your feedback! Based on your input, I am rolling out a new update to address as many issues as possible.

- Guide trail now points directly to the next checkpoint instead of level's end.
- Worked on some of the areas towards the end of the octopus level (second level) to avoid frustrating scenarios where things get too ambiguous, player gets stuck, etc.
- Increased stamina a bit for climbing and gliding
- Moved a checkpoint in first level to make guide trail more obvious
- Worked on the splash level's floating rocks labyrinth. Got rid of one way to solve it which was frustrating and unintended. Added an hint.
- Added a text hint about respawning when character is idling.
- Fixed a misplaced critter in the snake level.
- Optimized torch a bit in the cave level. (for better performance on Steam deck, to be confirmed if that is good enough)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: Updated the second level's end: Moved the end level's volume closer to reduce ambiguity about where to go. Before, you had to stay on the octopus for a while to reach the end of the level, now this happens much faster.

notes.title: Chasing the Unseen - Available Today!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! Dive into the world of 'Chasing the Unseen' as it officially launches on Steam today.

In this single-player adventure, you'll take on the role of a lone boy exploring abstract landscapes, climbing colossal creatures, and unraveling the mysteries of a surreal realm. Inspired by classics like Journey and Shadow of the Colossus, 'Chasing the Unseen' offers a unique blend of serene exploration and challenging platforming.

Get ready to traverse maze-like landscapes and encounter majestic giants. Embrace the climb, and find out what lies beyond the unseen.

notes.title: Shadow of the Colossus meets Journey in titan-climbing new indie game
notes.notes:
Hotly anticipated indie adventure Chasing the Unseen has unveiled its Steam release date at ComicCon Stuttgart as part of its Be a Hero event. The single-player title that invites players to climb gargantuan beasts traveling through surreal landscapes, akin to Shadow of the Colossus, is out early next year.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
"Chasing the Unseen" will hit Steam on [b]March 7th, 2024[/b].

Explore surreal landscapes and climb colossal creatures in this mesmerizing adventure.

Nominated at [url=https://indiecup.net/canada/nominees/]Indie Cup Canada'23[/url] in three categories, including "[b]Most Anticipated Game[/b]", the journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. Very grateful for the recognition and support.

Join this enigmatic expedition by following [url=https://twitter.com/strangeshift]@strangeshift[/url] on Twitter, where more updates will be shared as we approach the release.

Adventure awaits on March 7th. Wishlist "Chasing the Unseen" now and be prepared for an exceptional journey into the unseen.
